host.title: eHealth & Telemedicine Program
host.organization: B.P. Koirala Institute of Health Sciences

agenda.summary: Telemedicine is helping connect people in remote communities with specialist doctors and improve access to healthcare. With support from the University of Geneva (gdHub), Switzerland, the e-Health and Telemedicine Program at B.P. Koirala Institute of Health Sciences (BPKIHS) is providing telemedicine services through 107 health facilities across 56 local levels in all 14 districts of Koshi Province, Nepal. Health workers in rural facilities play a key role in delivering these services. Their experiences, efforts, and practical knowledge have helped the program grow and provided valuable lessons about what works well and what needs improvement. As the program develops, the focus is shifting from introducing telemedicine to making its delivery more effective, reliable, and accessible. Learning from health workers' experiences is essential to this process. Strengthening Telemedicine Together brings health workers and partners together to share successful practices, discuss challenges, identify practical solutions, and strengthen skills and collaboration.
